verdict.rationale: Fathom documents an official MCP server that connects meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT and any MCP-compatible client via a hosted server URL (https://api.fathom.ai/mcp). It also ships as an official Claude connector and offers a one-line Claude Code setup, so no glue code is needed. Missing for 10: the specific MCP tools for search, transcripts and action items are not enumerated in the MCP docs, the MCP auth flow is described only as "authenticate" rather than explicitly as OAuth, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
